purpose: Establish exact source provenance, schemas, timestamps, event classes, symbol coverage, state semantics and outcome exposure before any BTC candidate formula is proposed.
inventory_tasks: Identify exact file existence, path metadata and content SHA256 without modifying source files.
Record schemas, row counts, symbol counts and transition counts without interpreting future trade outcomes.
Identify genuine source event timestamp, collection timestamp, M7C decision timestamp and their clock domains.
Verify M7C prospective start and runtime manifest consistency from existing status artifacts.
Classify SOURCE_MATCHED, MISSED_SOURCE, EXTRA_CANDIDATE and UNSUPPORTED event representations.
Determine duplicate, revision, late-event and cursor behavior.
Determine whether BTCUSD source and the existing BTC candle source are compatible or require an explicit mapping audit.
Create an outcome-exposure inventory; unknown exposure is treated as exposed.
Return unresolved questions before any event snapshot, formula grammar or performance evaluation is implemented.
stop_conditions: M7C or collector abnormal status is detected.
M7C prospective start differs from the frozen contract.
Exact source provenance or clock domain cannot be established.
A required source artifact is missing or internally inconsistent.
user_action: Upload one ZIP containing the seven existing M7C files. Do not stop, restart or edit M7C/collector.
